Section 3 defines request provenance, purchasing power, delivery and additional use. Section 4 specifies the earning and licensed-playback path, matched controls and play-transfer scoring. Section 5 defines catalogue-switching and cost measures. Section 6 specifies grant conservation, recovery and revocation under synthetic faults. Section 7 describes implementation and evidence requirements.
